lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid; density increases significantly in the anterior region (left) while spacing increases in the posterior region (right).
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible in the mid-flank, intersecting with horizontal spot alignments to form a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by sharp highlights on the dorsal-facing surfaces and deep shadows on the ventral-facing surfaces.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5-8 high-luminance spots are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, partially obscured by motion blur.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark elongated objects (commensal fish) are visible attached to or swimming near the lower-mid lateral flank.
